GitHub security best practices require pinning to immutable references (commit SHAs or signed tags) for third-party actions/workflows.

Changing toolkit_ref from a pinned commit to 'main' compounds the supply-chain risk. If the reusable workflow uses this parameter to check out or reference toolkit code, tracking main means unpredictable behavior and potential compromise. This should remain pinned to the same immutable reference.
